CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-ai-thinking                /* Base thinking indicator */
.zak-ai-thinking-dots           /* Bouncing dots container */
.zak-ai-thinking-dot            /* Individual bouncing dot */
.zak-ai-thinking-spinner        /* Spinner circle */
.zak-ai-thinking-text           /* Label text */
.zak-ai-thinking-progress       /* Progress bar container */
.zak-ai-thinking-progress-bar   /* Progress bar track */
.zak-ai-thinking-progress-fill  /* Animated progress fill */
.zak-ai-thinking-steps          /* Multi-step container */
.zak-ai-thinking-step           /* Individual step row */
.zak-ai-thinking-step.done      /* Completed step */
.zak-ai-thinking-step.active    /* Currently processing step */
.zak-ai-thinking-step.pending   /* Not yet started step */
.zak-ai-thinking-step-icon      /* Step number/check icon */
.zak-ai-thinking-time           /* Elapsed time text */
.zak-ai-thinking-elaborate      /* Elaborate with description */
.zak-ai-thinking-elaborate-label/* "Thinking" label */
.zak-ai-thinking-elaborate-text /* Description text */

/* Key Animations */
@keyframes think-bounce  { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:0.4} 30%{transform:translateY(-6px);opacity:1} }
@keyframes think-spin    { to{transform:rotate(360deg)} }
@keyframes think-progress{ 0%{width:5%} 50%{width:65%} 100%{width:100%} }

JavaScript

Elapsed timer for the multi-step thinking indicator.

HTML
// Elapsed time counter
const elapsed = document.getElementById('think-elapsed');
if (elapsed) {
    let seconds = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
        seconds += 0.1;
        elapsed.textContent = seconds.toFixed(1) + 's';
    }, 100);
    // Stop after 5 seconds
    setTimeout(() => clearInterval(timer), 5000);
}

// Advance thinking steps
function advanceStep(container) {
    const active = container.querySelector('.zak-ai-thinking-step.active');
    const next = active?.nextElementSibling;
    if (active) {
        active.classList.remove('active');
        active.classList.add('done');
        active.querySelector('.zak-ai-thinking-step-icon').textContent = 'âœ“';
    }
    if (next) next.classList.add('active');
}
